description: Convert a complete DAW project between Logic Pro (.logicx), Ableton Live (.als), FL Studio (.flp), Pro Tools (.ptx), REAPER (.rpp), Cubase (.cpr) and Dorico (.dorico/.musicxml) — any pair, both ways, rebuilt natively in the target: tracks, MIDI, audio clips, tempo and markers arrive editable (Logic↔Ableton also automation, buses/sends, plugin state). ★ CUBASE AND DORICO ARE ASYMMETRIC (neither native format is documented; a file we cannot guarantee opens is never written): TO Cubase = a .dawproject (Cubase 14+/Nuendo import it as an editable session; Studio One and Bitwig too), not a .cpr; TO Dorico = MusicXML (.mxl, Dorico's own full-notation import; MuseScore/Finale/Sibelius open it too), not a .dorico. FROM Cubase reads the .cpr (tracks, tempo, signature, MIDI parts carry; the audio pool does not — audio tracks arrive named but empty). FROM Dorico a .dorico carries its players and flows but NOT its notes (score.dtn has no note positions): export MusicXML from Dorico and convert THAT (.musicxml/.mxl accepted under dorico2*). Every result carries a transfer REPORT: `report`, `lossy`, `summary[]` (what changed) and `warnings[]` (read before opening) — relay them; silence is never "lossless". Upload first with doseedo_get_project_upload_url + PUT (zip a project FOLDER so its audio travels; a bare project file works too; past ~4 GB it hands you a multipart upload). Directions: "<source>2<target>"; "auto2<target>" detects the source; "<daw>2<daw>" rebuilds in place (e.g. options.third_party_plugins:"disable"). To EDIT a project use doseedo_import_project (→ session_id); to convert a session the tools built: doseedo_download_session → upload that zip → logic2<target> (the converter takes an uploaded project, not a session_id). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (15 s–2 min; `stage`, `queue_position`); `file` is a direct storage link (multi-GB safe). Cancel: no stop — a running conversion completes, the job ends canceled, output discarded; the credit is refunded only when the conversion itself fails.

direction.description: Source and target as "<source>2<target>" (logic | ableton | fl | protools | reaper | cubase | dorico), "auto2<target>" to let the server detect the source, or "<daw>2<daw>" to rebuild in the same format. cubase2* reads a .cpr and *2cubase writes a .dawproject (Cubase 14+/Nuendo open it natively). dorico2* reads a .dorico, .musicxml or .mxl and *2dorico writes MusicXML (.mxl).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

options.description: Conversion options (all optional). third_party_plugins:"disable" drops third-party AU/VST devices so the export opens clean on a machine without them; stock_plugins:"disable" leaves stock devices unmapped instead of mapping to the nearest target-DAW device; carry_plugin_presets:false strips plugin patches; lossless:true (→Logic) pins the project to the MAX clip sample rate so no clip is downsampled; project_rate (→Logic) pins an exact rate in Hz; silence_empty_sampler:false (→Logic) keeps Logic's audible default Quick Sampler on tracks whose sampler had no sample; source_name = the project's display name for the output file.

source_name.description: Display name of the source project, e.g. "My Song.als" — names the output.

project_key.description: R2 key of the uploaded project (from doseedo_get_project_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/signed-url; starts with "uploads/").

name: doseedo_convert_project
